spanish: Y cuando seduce varón a virgen que no está desposada, y yace con ella, dotando la dotará a sí a mujer.

findings.issue: ל + אִשָּׁה is the role for/as a wife; bare “a mujer” can be read as a second indirect object beside “a sí”.

notes: Persons, the pual, the 3fs suffix, and the cognate infinitive absolute are represented.
